 Atlético Madrid and Barcelona have produced absolute thrillers over the last two years. | Alex Caparros/UEFA/Getty Images (Atlético Madrid badge), James Gill/Danehouse/Getty Images (Barcelona badge) Atletico Madrid vs. Barcelona: Preview, Predictions and Lineups 
 The result of Sunday’s match will determine who sits atop the La Liga standings heading into the November international break. Roberto Casillas | Share on Facebook Share on X Add us as a preferred source Atlético Madrid and Barcelona have produced absolute thrillers over the last two years. | Alex Caparros/UEFA/Getty Images (Atlético Madrid badge), James Gill/Danehouse/Getty Images (Barcelona badge) The top spot in La Liga is up for grabs on Sunday when Barcelona visit Atlético Madrid at the Metropolitano for the highlight fixture of the weekend in European soccer. 
--> The top spot in La Liga is up for grabs on Sunday when Barcelona visit Atlético Madrid at the Metropolitano for the highlight fixture of the weekend in European soccer. 
 The pair of Spanish rivals met six times a season ago and although Barcelona won both league meetings en route to back-to-back titles, Atlético Madrid eliminated Hansi Flick’s side from both the Copa del Rey and the Champions League . 
--> The pair of Spanish rivals met six times a season ago and although Barcelona won both league meetings en route to back-to-back titles, Atlético Madrid eliminated Hansi Flick’s side from both the Copa del Rey and the Champions League . 
 Diego Simeone’s men are the most in-form team in La Liga having won seven straight to climb to second in the standings heading into the weekend, just two points back of the Blaugrana. 
--> Diego Simeone’s men are the most in-form team in La Liga having won seven straight to climb to second in the standings heading into the weekend, just two points back of the Blaugrana. 
 Barcelona have been sensational to start the campaign, but falling against Real Madrid a fortnight ago allowed the chasing pack to cut the gap to the summit, and now Atlético Madrid will be eager to extend Barça’s shaky big game record in recent months. 
--> Barcelona have been sensational to start the campaign, but falling against Real Madrid a fortnight ago allowed the chasing pack to cut the gap to the summit, and now Atlético Madrid will be eager to extend Barça’s shaky big game record in recent months. 
 There’s no love lost between two Spanish giants, and following a summer in which the two clubs headlined the most controversial transfer saga of the window in the form of Barça’s pursuit of Julián Alvarez, the animosity between them is at an all time high heading into Sunday’s clash. 
--> There’s no love lost between two Spanish giants, and following a summer in which the two clubs headlined the most controversial transfer saga of the window in the form of Barça’s pursuit of Julián Alvarez, the animosity between them is at an all time high heading into Sunday’s clash. 
 The stakes couldn’t be much higher for a November meeting, Barcelona could open a five-point gap to Atléti with a win, but defeat would see Simeone’s side enter the November international break leading the La Liga title race. 
--> The stakes couldn’t be much higher for a November meeting, Barcelona could open a five-point gap to Atléti with a win, but defeat would see Simeone’s side enter the November international break leading the La Liga title race.

 Lamine Yamal is playing like the best in the world. | Jose Breton/Pics Action/NurPhoto/Getty Images Both teams will go all out for victory on Sunday, deploying their strongest XI possible in the last game before the international break looking for a win that puts them top of the La Liga standings. 
--> Both teams will go all out for victory on Sunday, deploying their strongest XI possible in the last game before the international break looking for a win that puts them top of the La Liga standings. 
 The pair of rivals have headlined some of the best, most entertaining games in Spanish soccer over the last two seasons, and their first meeting of 2026–27 should continue the trend. 
--> The pair of rivals have headlined some of the best, most entertaining games in Spanish soccer over the last two seasons, and their first meeting of 2026–27 should continue the trend. 
 No team has better exploited Hansi Flick’s aggressive, high defensive line than Atlético Madrid, so the hosts will be confident they can harm the visitors again. Still, Barcelona have also found multiple ways to bypass Atléti’s defense in recent meetings, and given how prolific they’ve been offensively to start the year, they should be able to find success up front.
--> No team has better exploited Hansi Flick’s aggressive, high defensive line than Atlético Madrid, so the hosts will be confident they can harm the visitors again. Still, Barcelona have also found multiple ways to bypass Atléti’s defense in recent meetings, and given how prolific they’ve been offensively to start the year, they should be able to find success up front.
 Both teams will land punches and have their moments, but Barcelona should narrowly edge Los Rojiblancos to keep the La Liga top spot in a stellar match. 
--> Both teams will land punches and have their moments, but Barcelona should narrowly edge Los Rojiblancos to keep the La Liga top spot in a stellar match. 
 Barça’s Metropolitano record in the league : The Catalans have won in each of their last four league visits to Atlético Madrid and have only lost twice in their nine league trips to the Metropolitano. 
 Barça’s ridiculous attacking form : Barcelona have scored 46 goals in La Liga this season, the best scoring record through 11 games to start a season since 1930. 
 Atléti’s attack against Barça’s suspect defense : The hosts have scored seven goals in their last three home league games; meanwhile, Barcelona have failed to keep a clean sheet in their last five away trips in all competitions. 
 No draws : Atléti and Barça haven’t drawn in each of their last eight meetings and there’s only been one draw in the most recent 16 matches of the rivalry.

--> Simeone will have to work around the injury of center back Cristian Romero, but he’ll be pleased with the return of the midfield duo of Morten Hjulmand and Johnny Cardoso, with the former expected to start on Sunday. 
 Marc Pubill is the favorite to replace Romero in Simeone’s otherwise first-choice backline with Marcos Llorente, David Hancko and Alejandro Grimaldo. 
--> Marc Pubill is the favorite to replace Romero in Simeone’s otherwise first-choice backline with Marcos Llorente, David Hancko and Alejandro Grimaldo.

 But defense remains the biggest area of concern for Flick. Although Eric García and Andreas Christensen are back in training, it might be too soon for the duo to feature from the start. Brian Fariñas should keep his place at right back with João Cancelo covering the left flank. 
--> But defense remains the biggest area of concern for Flick. Although Eric García and Andreas Christensen are back in training, it might be too soon for the duo to feature from the start. Brian Fariñas should keep his place at right back with João Cancelo covering the left flank.
